channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Scoggins: I was wrong about Sam Darnold. The Vikings should have kept him.
item.description: The Seahawks are in Super Bowl LX because the former Vikings quarterback proved he’s capable of performing in the clutch.

item.title: Wild rally from three-goal deficit to beat Blackhawks in a shootout
item.description: Kirill Kaprizov scored the only goal in the shootout, and Jesper Wallstedt recovered from a rough start to anchor the victory.

item.title: This suburban dad’s rant became touchpoint of ICE opposition
item.description: A candid, profanity-laced interview turned a bald soccer dad into an unlikely activist as federal agents clamped down on Minneapolis.

item.title: Is ICE rolling back operations in Minnesota? It’s hard to tell.
item.description: Federal agents are still on the streets of the Twin Cities a day after the Trump administration announced a change in immigration enforcement in Minnesota.

item.title: U.S. Holocaust Museum criticizes Walz’s Anne Frank comparison
item.description: Minnesota children are hiding in their homes not unlike Anne Frank, Gov. Walz said during a news conference after the fatal shooting of Alex Pretti by federal agents.

item.title: ‘Patience is at an end’: Federal judge orders ICE director to appear in court
item.description: Chief District Judge Patrick Schiltz said the agency has repeatedly violated orders to release detainees.

item.title: Republicans in Minnesota were bullish about their election chances. Then ICE arrived.
item.description: Just a few weeks ago, the GOP was riding a wave of momentum with fraud dominating the state’s political dialogue. Now the party is on its heels.

item.title: Democrats win two special elections for Minnesota House seats
item.description: The results will restore the state House to a 67-67 tie before the legislative session that begins in February.

item.title: Report: Border Patrol agent yelled ‘He’s got a gun!’ before Alex Pretti was killed
item.description: The report, sent to members of Congress, does not say Pretti threatened agents during a scuffle in Minneapolis.

item.title: The latest: Rep. Ilhan Omar sprayed with unknown substance at town hall
item.description: A preliminary report to Congress by federal investigators into the fatal shooting of Alex Pretti said two agents fired, and it made no mention of Pretti holding his own weapon.
